example.raw: Ok, even with expedited shipping, the arrangement for my wife's birthday arrived... the next day... the day AFTER they were supposed to be delivered. I had to call them to check the status, and their only offer was to credit the before noon delivery fee. So for $68.71 what I was supposed to get, looked NOTHING like the photo on their website.
